study type: secondary analysis of a prospective longitudinal cohort study
cohort: The study included 306 pregnant patients recruited between December 2020 and July 2022, categorized into low and highest Area Deprivation Index groups based on their address at delivery.
finding: Patients in the highest Area Deprivation Index group were significantly more likely to experience extremely preterm birth (<28 weeks and <34 weeks), contract SARS-CoV-2 infection, and be hospitalized due to COVID-19 compared to those in the low ADI group.
